searchText: Attestation rewards are scaled according to how much of the total stake attested in the epoch. So if 90% of validators showed up, only 90% of the total possible reward for each validator is available (roughly - the inclusion delay reward is not scaled iirc). This may not be relevant to the question at hand 😅 Yeah that I was aware of. Just the inverse, not so much.
